description: Live traffic cameras on the national freeways, provincial highways or a city’s roads, by road, place or distance, with the link to each live stream (open it to watch; TDX gives no still images). Example: network "freeway", keyword "林口"; or network "Taipei", lat 25.0478, lon 121.517.

direction.description: Only devices facing traffic heading this way (S also matches SE and SW).

keyword.description: Only results whose road or place contains this, e.g. "國道1號", "林口", "建國高架".

limit.description: Maximum number of cameras to return (default 10).

network.description: Road network: "freeway" (國道, national freeways), "highway" (省道, provincial highways) or a city (Taipei, Taoyuan, Taichung, 臺北市, ...).

name: traffic_cameras
title: Traffic cameras
